author: Tech_Bender
body:
[https://orna.guide/](https://orna.guide/) Best resource for info about the game   
[https://www.reddit.com/r/OrnaRPG/comments/bl9o22/orna\_faq/](https://www.reddit.com/r/OrnaRPG/comments/bl9o22/orna_faq/) this is also good info.

​

Best way to earn orns early game is to do achievements which can be found under the status screen by clicking your character and clicking the heart icon. Also bosses will drop lucky silver coins, these things are worth more than gold as they increase the orns you earn when fighting monsters. 

Luck shrines are also really useful for getting better drops which means better equipment to make the game easier. Your first goal should be to find a blacksmith that you can come back to easily until you can build your own. When you find good gear that you feel will last you a while you will want to upgrade it which takes several days in real time to upgrade it to level 10 (max). 

Once you hit level 50 you will want to start killing golems for stone, walking woods for wood, or Ogres for stone and wood, you will need it for building your keep and your own stores and blacksmith. 

Those rings represent the boundary of an area. You can see what areas you're in by clicking that button on the bottom right corner with the shield. If you want to see other players near by you can click on your character in the middle, then on the left side of the ring click the Party boot icon. It will show you if you're in a party with someone or who is near by that you can party up with. 

Every 25 levels you hit an increased difficulty wall in the form of new higher level harder monsters.
